description: This file defines utility functions and types for handling keyboard shortcut keybindings in a VSCode extension, including reading user configurations, default keybindings, and formatting key strings for display.

methods.name: getKeybindingsForCommands
methods.description: Retrieves keybindings for a list of commands, checking user config and falling back to defaults.

methods.name: getKeybindingForCommand
methods.description: Gets the keybinding for a specific command, considering user config and defaults.

methods.name: getDefaultKeybindingForCommand
methods.description: Fetches the default keybinding for a command from package.json, platform-specific.

methods.name: findAnyBindingForCommand
methods.description: Finds a keybinding entry for a command within a list.

methods.name: prettyPrintKey
methods.description: Formats raw key strings into a human-readable format.

methods.name: mapModifierKey
methods.description: Maps modifier keys to platform-specific display names.

methods.name: mapSpecialKey
methods.description: Maps special keys to display names.

methods.name: normalizeKeyToken
methods.description: Normalizes individual key tokens to display format.
